structure.rule: A reason to act, play, explore, solve, communicate or create.
Space/materials/possible prompts, not a script of child answers.
Questions and interventions conditional on what happens.
Natural moments where the criterion can be observed.
Socialize/represent/revisit or continue later; closure need not be worksheet.

v4_1_didactic_reasoning: Seleccionar una familia de situación compatible con propósito/competencia/contexto antes de redactar inicio-desarrollo-cierre.
Generar acciones infantiles antes que instrucciones docentes.
Mediación debe ser contingente: pregunta/intervención + condición de uso, no libreto fijo.
Ofrecer evidencia natural dentro de la acción; no añadir ficha si no es necesaria.
Aplicar adaptación de edad del dominio junto con age_reference oficial.
v4_1_lineage_guardrails: When confirmed Project/Unit Master and activity map context exist, preserve the row's situation, purpose, date, position, competencies and continuity.
Use domain knowledge to enrich child actions, conditional mediation, materials, age adaptation and evidence opportunities; never replace the confirmed activity.
